followup_explanation:
This was a straightforward algebra question with no sensitive or harm-adjacent content, so the decision came down purely to capability. Dunlin-235B leads on essentially every relevant benchmark and eval—MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.8), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 54.3), IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6), Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4)—including the reasoning and instruction-following metrics most relevant to clean, accurate math work.

The task preference differences between the two models only matter for distasteful-but-permissible or ethically fraught content, which doesn't apply here. So Dunlin was the clear choice on raw capability.

ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
